title: Natan bar Mar Zutra

paragraphs: Mentioned in [Sanhedrin 29a](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.29a.23): Rav Ashi said, “Natan bar Mar Zutra told me: False witnesses are despised even by those who hire them.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=2741&lang=en) cites the same passage, where Rav Ashi says that Natan told him the statement.
The remark concerns the contempt of the people who hire false witnesses.
